summary: Företag 20 develops nanowire-based transistor technology for high-frequency and high-performance semiconductor applications. The company commercializes research originating from Svedala komun.
target_market: Global semiconductor and advanced electronics market
strategy_notes: Focused on commercializing nanowire transistor technology for next-generation wireless communications and semiconductor applications.
technology_notes: Develops vertical nanowire transistor architectures intended to improve performance, scalability and energy efficiency in advanced semiconductor devices.
risk_notes: Dependent on semiconductor industry adoption, successful scale-up, funding availability and competition from established semiconductor technologies.
